implementation: Plan and apply share one operation lock; source, evidence, topology, boot and resource snapshots are checked under it and again after precopy.
Durable schema-2 claims and phase intents use complete writes and file/parent fsync; partial or unreadable attempts block replay.
Candidate-start intent is persisted before Docker start; its in-memory barrier also forbids blind rollback if that journal write fails. Accepted attempts permanently block initial-cutover replay.

Legacy seal mount IDs/options and gate inode/content identities constrain rollback; preexisting or foreign resources are preserved, and all resource cleanup is preflighted before any rollback mutation.
Enable symlink identity is captured in private staging before no-overwrite publication; same-target replacements, unsupported publication and ambiguous stages block cleanup.
Actual rollback_prestart integrations verify owned teardown and legacy targets before Docker restart; failed commands or failed legacy acceptance cannot report restoration.
Every original restart policy is attempted and read back, including on-failure retry limits; partial quiesce failures trigger checked restoration.
Candidate and legacy acceptance require exact container IDs, names, project services and policies with bounded health/HTTP/tunnel stabilization and final encrypted-bind/topology checks.

Process/thread inventory covers FD, cwd, root and mappings, matching device/inode identities through external aliases and original source paths. Ambiguous unlinked references on legacy filesystems and unreadable inventories block acceptance.

limitations: Temporary files, synthetic proc trees, mount-table models and explicit subprocess fakes exercise behavior; no real vault, mount, daemon lifecycle or secret migration is exercised by these tests.

Proc reference observations are not an atomic proof about every possible kernel-held reference or future writer. Ambiguous unlinked references can conservatively block legitimate workloads and require reconciliation.
Manifest fields attest paths, types, mode, ownership, sizes and file hashes. rsync copies extended metadata with -aHAX; the manifest does not independently attest all xattr/ACL contents.
Interrupted or uncertain resource ownership remains a reconciliation barrier; this source follow-up does not attest live crash recovery or host-state activation.
